Physical: reduced by armour and can cause Bleed or Poison.
Fire: reduced by fire resistance and builds Flammability toward Burn.
Cold: reduced by cold resistance and builds Freeze.
Lightning: reduced by lightning resistance and can Shock or build Electrocute.
Void: reduced by void resistance, contributes to Poison, and costs twice its health damage when absorbed by Energy Shield.

Weapon base and flat rune damage are assembled first. Local physical percentage scales the weapon itself. Character bonuses then apply according to element, melee/ranged/projectile category, one-handed/dual-wield/two-handed state, weapon type, afflicted conditions, conversions, and extra-damage effects.

The base RPG critical chance is 5% and base multiplier is 150%. Vanilla jump criticals are disabled: jumping does not guarantee a critical. A successful critical uses the mod's chance and multiplier, can guarantee chance-based Poison, Bleed, or Shock checks, and can activate recent-critical conditions.

Spears, bows, crossbows, and tridents count as two-handed.
A non-two-handed weapon counts as one-handed.
Dual wielding requires the main-hand and off-hand equipment to resolve to the same one-handed weapon type.
A thrown trident preserves the statistics of the thrown item, but its total compatible attribute value is multiplied by about 0.6667 for the throw.
Damage floaters show the final elemental breakdown after conversion and resistance processing, which makes them useful for testing a build.
